sentences.en: Some taxpayers use tax havens to avoid paying their taxes.
sentences.zh: 一些纳税人利用避税港来逃避缴纳税款。

sentences.en: The four boys, in fact, haven’t broken any rules.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这四个男孩并没有违反任何规定。

sentences.en: The church was a safe haven for the destitute paupers.
sentences.zh: 这座教堂是那些贫困潦倒者的安全庇护所。

senses.zh: 为……提供避难处；安置……于港中
